answer: By the comet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The wharf is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the quill.
